blocks.text: Coulomb ka qanoon (law) electrostatics ka bunyadi usool hai. Yeh batata hai ke do charged cheezon ke darmiyan kitni force lagti hai. Charges ke darmiyan force ki pehli paimaish (measurement) French physicist Charles de Coulomb ne ki. Charged particles ka rawayya aur bohat se electrical mazahir (phenomena) samajhne ke liye yeh qanoon zaroori hai. Apni paimaishon ki bunyad par Coulomb ne yeh qanoon diya:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is paimaish ka saal 1874 likhti hai. Lekin kitab ke apne box ke mutabiq Coulomb 1736 se 1806 tak zinda rahe, is liye 1874 mumkin nahi. Coulomb ne torsion balance se apni paimaishein 1785 mein shaya (publish) kin; sahi saal 1785 hai.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. (a) Do narangi charges +q1 aur +q2, faasla r; q1 par force F12 baen taraf, q2 par F21 daen taraf, yani ek doosre se door. (b) Narangi +q1 aur neela -q2, faasla r; q1 par F12 daen aur q2 par F21 baen, yani ek doosre ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.1: (a) aik jaise charges mein dafa (repulsion) ki forces aur (b) mukhalif charges mein kashish (attraction) ki forces (kitab ki Figure 9.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono halaton mein forces charges ko milane wali seedhi lakeer par hain aur barabar magar ulat simt mein hain (F₁₂ = −F₂₁). (a) Aik jaise (like) charges ek doosre ko door dhakelte (repel) hain. (b) Mukhalif (unlike) charges ek doosre ko kheenchte (attract) hain.

blocks.title: Coulomb ka qanoon
blocks.text: Do point charges ke darmiyan force un ke charges ke hasil-e-zarb (product) ke seedhe tanasub (directly proportional) mein aur un ke darmiyani faasle ke square ke ulte tanasub (inversely proportional) mein hoti hai. Formula mein:

blocks.text_alt: F ∝ q₁q₂/r²  ya  F = k q₁q₂/r²   (9.1)

blocks.text: Yahan F woh mushtarka (mutual) force hai jo dono point charges q₁ aur q₂ mein se har ek par lagti hai, aur r un ka darmiyani faasla hai. Force F hamesha dono charges ko milane wali lakeer par lagti hai (Fig. 9.1). k proportionality constant hai. Is ki qeemat do cheezon par munhasir hai: charges ke darmiyan medium (beech ka maadda) kaisa hai, aur F, q aur r kis unit system mein naape gaye hain. Agar beech mein free space (khala) ho aur units SI hon to:
Yahan ε₀ ek electrical constant hai jise free space ki permittivity kehte hain. SI units mein is ki qeemat 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻² hai. ε₀ ki qeemat rakhne se:
Is tarah free space mein Coulomb ki force yeh hai:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Faasla do guna karein to force chauthai (1/4) reh jati hai, kyun ke force r² ke ulte tanasub mein hai. Kisi ek charge ko do guna karein to force bhi do guni ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Ghaur karein (Point to ponder)
blocks.text: Kya charged aur be-charge (uncharged) cheez ke darmiyan electrostatic force hoti hai?
Coulomb ki force mushtarka (mutual) hai: agar q₁, q₂ par force lagata hai to q₂ bhi q₁ par barabar aur ulat force lagata hai. q₁ ki q₂ par force ko F₂₁ aur q₂ ki q₁ par force ko F₁₂ likhein to:

Dono forces ki miqdar ek hi hai aur Eq. 9.3 se milti hai. Simt (direction) batane ke liye unit vectors lete hain: r̂₂₁ woh unit vector hai jo q₁ se q₂ ki taraf hai, aur r̂₁₂ woh jo q₂ se q₁ ki taraf hai. Phir:

blocks.alt: Do tirchhe hisse. (a) q1 (neeche baen) aur q2 (oopar daen), faasla r; q2 par surkh teer F21 q1 se door, saath chhota siyah unit vector r21 (hat) usi simt mein. (b) q1 par surkh teer F12 q2 se door, saath unit vector r12 (hat).
blocks.caption: Figure 9.2 (kitab ki Figure 9.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Unit vector r̂₂₁ q₁ se q₂ ki taraf hai aur r̂₁₂ q₂ se q₁ ki taraf, is liye r̂₂₁ = −r̂₁₂. Yahan dono charges aik jaise hain, is liye har force doosre charge se door ki taraf hai.
Forces F₂₁ aur F₁₂ Fig. 9.2 (a aur b) mein dikhayi gayi hain. Chunke r̂₂₁ = −r̂₁₂, Eqs. 9.5 aur 9.6 se:
Charges ke signs (+ ya −) tay karte hain ke force kashish (attraction) ki hai ya dafa (repulsion) ki: q₁q₂ musbat ho to dhakelne wali, manfi ho to kheenchne wali.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan Fig. 12.2, Eqs. 12.5 aur aage Table 12.1 aur Eq. 12.3 likhti hai (purani kitab ke number). Is chapter mein in se murad Fig. 9.2, Eqs. 9.5 aur 9.6, Table 9.1 aur Eq. 9.3 hain.

Ab dekhte hain ke charges ke darmiyan medium force par kya asar dalta hai. Agar medium insulator ho to use dielectric kehte hain. Tajurbe se pata chala hai ke dielectric hamesha force ko free space ke muqable mein ek khaas factor se kam kar deta hai; yeh factor har dielectric ke liye constant hota hai. Is constant ko relative permittivity kehte hain aur εᵣ se likhte hain. Mukhtalif dielectrics ki relative permittivity Table 9.1 mein hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki table mein "Glass Mica" ek hi line mein chhapa hai, is liye wahan se neeche har qeemat ek line neeche khisak gayi hai aur 78.5 akeli line mein reh gayi hai. Upar table mein har qeemat apne material ke saamne rakhi gayi hai: Glass 4.8-10, Mica 3-7.5, Paraffined paper 2, Plexiglass 3.40, Rubber 2.94, Teflon 2.1, Transformer oil 2.1, Water 78.5.
Is tarah relative permittivity εᵣ wale medium mein Coulomb ki force yeh hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Eq. 9.7 mein εᵣ chhapa hi nahi; woh free space wali equation jaisi lagti hai. Medium mein force εᵣ guna kam hoti hai, is liye sahi equation F = (1/4πε₀εᵣ)(q₁q₂/r²) hai.
Table se dekhein: hawa ke liye εᵣ = 1.0006 hai, jo 1 ke bohat qareeb hai. Is liye hawa mein force ke liye bhi Eq. 9.3 (free space wali) bohat kam ghalti ke saath istemal ho sakti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Pani ka εᵣ 78.5 hai, yani pani mein do charges ke darmiyan force hawa ke muqable taqreeban 78 guna kam hoti hai. Isi liye namak (NaCl) pani mein jaldi ghul jata hai: ions ke darmiyan kashish bohat kamzor ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Example 9.1: kone par q1 = +40 microcoulomb; ufuqi lakeer par r2 = 0.15 m par q2 = -60 microcoulomb; 60 degree wali lakeer par r3 = 0.12 m par q3 = -50 microcoulomb. q1 se magenta teer F2 aur F3 q2 aur q3 ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.2(a) (kitab ki Figure 9.2(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Dashed axes x'-x aur y'-y par free-body diagram. F2 +x ki taraf. F3 60 degree par oopar daen; us ke hisse F3 cos 60 (x par) aur F3 sin 60 (y par) teeron se, dashed lakeerein mustateel poora karti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.2(b) (kitab ki Figure 9.2(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: q₂ aur q₃ dono manfi hain aur q₁ musbat, is liye q₁ par dono forces kashish ki hain: F₂ q₂ ki taraf aur F₃ q₃ ki taraf. Fig. 9.2(b) mein F₃ ko x aur y hisson (components) mein toda gaya hai: F₃ cos60° aur F₃ sin60°.

blocks.title: Example 9.1
blocks.problem: Teen point charges q₁ = +40 μC, q₂ = −60 μC aur q₃ = −50 μC ek hi satah (plane) mein hain (Fig. 9.2(a)): q₂, q₁ se 0.15 m door hai, aur q₃, q₁ se 0.12 m door aisi lakeer par hai jo q₁q₂ ke saath 60° banati hai. q₁ par kul (net) force ki miqdar aur simt nikalein.
steps: q₂ ki q₁ par force kashish ki hai (charges mukhalif hain). Is ki miqdar: F₁₂ = k q₁q₂/r₂² = (9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²)(40 × 10⁻⁶ C)(60 × 10⁻⁶ C)/(0.15 m)² = 960 N
q₃ ki q₁ par force bhi kashish ki hai: F₁₃ = k q₁q₃/r₃² = (9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²)(40 × 10⁻⁶ C)(50 × 10⁻⁶ C)/(0.12 m)² = 1250 N
F₁₃ ke hisse (components): F₁₃ₓ = 1250 N × cos60° = 1250 N × 0.5 = 625 N; F₁₃ᵧ = 1250 N × sin60° = 1250 N × 0.86 = 1075 N
x-hissa: Fₓ = F₁₂ + F₁₃ cos60° = 960 N + 625 N = 1585 N
Simt: tanθ = Fᵧ/Fₓ = 1075/1585 = 0.68, is liye θ ≈ 34°
blocks.answer: q₁ par kul force taqreeban 1915 N hai, q₁ aur q₂ ko milane wali lakeer se 34° par.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Example 9.1 mein F = 1975 N likhti hai. Hisab karein: √(1585² + 1075²) = √3 667 850 = 1915 N. Sahi jawab taqreeban 1915 N hai; simt 34° theek hai. (Kitab F₁₃ mein r₂ aur (0.12 m²) bhi likhti hai; murad r₃ aur (0.12 m)² hai, jaisa upar likha hai.)

blocks.title: Kya aap jaante hain? (Do You Know?)
blocks.text: Van de Graaff generator ek electrostatic generator hai. Is mein ek chalti belt charge ko insulated column ke oopar lage khokhle (hollow) dhaat ke gole par jama karti hai. Is se bohat zyada voltage wala direct current (DC) banta hai, magar current bohat kam hota hai. Ise American physicist Robert J. Van de Graaff ne 1929 mein banaya. Jadeed generators 5 megavolts tak pohanch jate hain. Mez par rakhne wala chhota generator taqreeban 100,000 volts banata hai aur itni energy deta hai ke chingari (spark) nazar aati hai. Ek pulley insulating belt ko nokeeli dhaat ki kanghi (comb) ke paas se guzarti hai, jise power supply ne musbat charge diya hota hai. Belt se electrons nikal jate hain aur woh musbat charged ho jati hai. Oopar wali waisi hi kanghi yeh musbat charge gumbad (dome) par phaila deti hai. Sawal: Van de Graaff generator ko chhoone par baal kyun khade ho jate hain?

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Gumbad ko chhoone par charge aap ke jism aur har baal par phail jata hai. Har baal par ek hi qism ka charge hota hai, is liye baal ek doosre ko aur sar ko dhakelte (repel) hain aur khade ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Do point charges 10 m door hain; faasla 5 m karne par force ka kya hota hai (MCQ 9.1)? Do charges 5.0 cm par 0.4 N se dhakelte hain; 2.5 cm aur 15.0 cm par force nikalein (numerical 9.1). Kya charged aur be-charge cheez ke darmiyan electrostatic force hoti hai (Point to ponder)?
blocks.explanation: F, 1/r² ke tanasub mein hai, is liye faasla aadha karne se force chaar guna ho jati hai: option (d). 2.5 cm par faasla aadha hai: F = 4 × 0.4 N = 1.6 N. 15.0 cm par faasla teen guna hai: F = 0.4 N/9 = 0.044 N (kitab ka jawab 0.04 N). Haan: charged cheez be-charge cheez ke mukhalif charges ko qareeb kheench leti hai aur aik jaise charges ko door dhakel deti hai. Qareeb wale mukhalif charges zyada zor se kheenche jate hain, is liye kul force kashish ki hoti hai; isi liye ragri hui kanghi kaghaz ke tukre utha leti hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Coulomb ka qanoon: F = k q₁q₂/r² (9.1), force charges ko milane wali lakeer par; k = 1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻², ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻².
Aik jaise charges dhakelte, mukhalif kheenchte hain; F₁₂ = −F₂₁ (9.4); vector shaklein (9.5) aur (9.6).
Dielectric force ko εᵣ guna kam karta hai: F = (1/4πε₀εᵣ)(q₁q₂/r²); hawa 1.0006, pani 78.5.
Example 9.1: 960 N aur 1250 N mil kar 34° par taqreeban 1915 N.
